CACHE::hits
Description
Returns the document cache hits.
Syntax
CACHE
::
hits
CACHE::hits
Returns the document cache hits.
Examples
when
CACHE_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"[CACHE::hits] cache hits for document at [HTTP::uri]"
}
